name: CAMDA Health Privacy Challenge 2025
description: This record contains the preprocessed bulk gene-expression (RNA-seq) datasets (TCGA-BRCA and TCGA COMBINED) used in CAMDA Health Privacy Challenge 2025, and its accompanying paper: Towards Useful and Private Synthetic Omics: Community Benchmarking of Generative Models for Transcriptomics Data (bioRxiv, 2026). TCGA-BRCA.zip: Two files; preprocessed bulk RNA-seq breast cancer data and subtype information, respectively. TCGA-COMBINED.zip: Three files; preprocessed bulk RNA-seq of 10 cancer tissues and cancer type information, respectively and a held-out (preprocessed) bulk RNA-seq reference set to be used as auxiliary data. splits_indices.zip: Two files; YAML files required to split the datasets into 5 fold-cv subsets.
